hosts.reported_from: Taiwan (source prints Lithocarpus cuspidata; botanical spelling needs review); Taiwan (source prints Lithocarpus cuspidata; botanical spelling needs review)

host_note: A published host name was spelled Lithocarpus cuspidata; its botanical nomenclature requires confirmation. The original published form remains traceable.
taxonomy_summary: Crossotarsus sauteri Strohmeyer, 1913. Original description and historical taxonomic treatments are displayed with claim-specific source verification; provisional distribution and host assertions remain separate from nomenclatural decisions.
nomenclature_note: Strohmeyer (1913:164) originally printed Crossotarsus Sauteri; capitalization of the epithet is corrected to sauteri. The historical Crossotarsinulus combination and reported C. rengetensis relationship need separate verification.

resources.images: No image with confirmed public reuse rights is linked in this release.
resources.specimens: Specimen/type evidence is recorded in the cited original descriptions; specimen accessions have not been independently mapped to online repositories.

provenance.scope: Distribution and host entries are consolidated and accepted for website presentation; specific unresolved nomenclatural and biological qualifications remain separately annotated.
